ExpectedCoverage.Finding: Reviewed 2026-10-01: no usable intended-use or post-print finishing basis was found in the three reviewed cached originals for LUVOCOM 3F PAHT 9936 BK and PAHT KK 50056 BK FR (G148-01/G148-02). They provide material/processing and thermal/fire/rail context, predominantly compound/moulded specimens; the later 50056 sheet separately labels a printed V-0 specimen at0.4mm. Neither those labels, pellet predrying nor printing settings establish an application or finishing method. Official product/guide routes remain open; this is not public-source exhaustion or absence. 9936 BK/L remains a separate identity. Reviewed source basis: S-PET-TDS-LUVOCOM-3F-PAHT-9936-BK, R-3D4MAKERS-TDS-LUVOCOM-3F-PAHT-KK-50056-BK-FR-Filament-3D4Makers, D-LEHVOSS-LUVOCOM-3F-PAHT-KK-50056-BK-FR.

ProposedCoverage.Finding: Reviewed 2026-10-01: The official LEHVOSS Bus- und Bahnbau section explicitly lists PAHT KK 50056 BK FR (G148-02) under flame-resistant railway resin context. This is a bounded producer application context for the named compound, not printed-product qualification, a rail/fire certificate or evidence for G148-01 PAHT9936BK. Pellet processing and the other source printed V-0@0.4mm statement remain distinct; neighbouring9936BK/L food or magnetic claims do not transfer. Reviewed source basis: R-COVERAGE-20261001-14396b9c74a0.
